title: ChangeStreamMessage
description: Server-side change-stream payloads: the WS `ready` message, the WS `block` message, and the `listChanges` REST response. All three carry per-DID change envelopes (`$defs/ChangeEnvelope`). See `### Websocket Subscriptions` in the indexer spec.

Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets (e.g. `+02:00`), date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.

Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP.

ReadyMessage.description: Sent once on WebSocket upgrade, before any `subscribe` is processed.

block.description: Height of the next block the server will deliver via this WebSocket (i.e. `latestProcessedBlock + 1` at connect time). Clients use `block - 1` as the bootstrap snapshot point.

blockTime.description: Wall-clock time at which `block` was committed.

blockIntervalMs.description: Expected block production interval in milliseconds. Clients SHOULD treat 2× this value as the liveness timeout for both subscription confirmation and ongoing heartbeat detection.

SubscribedMessage.description: Acknowledges a processed `subscribe`. `block` is the height of the next block this subscription will deliver.

BlockMessage.description: Emitted once per processed block, in strictly increasing order of `block`. A `changes[]` array with zero entries still acts as a heartbeat / liveness signal: block production is the keepalive.

blockTime.description: Wall-clock time at which `block` was committed.

BlockEntry.description: A single block inside a `listChanges` response. Shape mirrors `BlockMessage` minus the `type` discriminator.

blockTime.description: Wall-clock time at which `block` was committed.

ListChangesResponse.description: Response shape for `GET /vt/v1/changes`. Returns up to `limit` blocks that contain at least one change matching the request filters; change-free blocks are omitted entirely. `nextFromBlock` lets the client jump over arbitrarily long change-free ranges in one hop.

currentBlock.description: Latest block the indexer has processed at the time of the response.

blocks.description: Up to `limit` blocks in strictly increasing order of `block`.

nextFromBlock.description: Smallest block height strictly greater than the last returned block (or strictly greater than `fromBlock` when `blocks` is empty) for which the indexer knows further changes exist. `null` when the response has reached `currentBlock`.

ChangeEnvelope.description: One change envelope per DID per block. Each `<channel>` flag is present iff the subscription includes that channel; the flag's value indicates whether the channel changed at this block. `trust` is the only channel whose new values are delivered inline.

trust.description: Inline trust-core values when `trust` is subscribed and any trust-core field changed at this block. `false` when subscribed but unchanged. Omitted when not subscribed.

corporation.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

participations.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

ecsCredentials.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

presentations.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

services.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

ecosystems.description: `true` iff the channel is subscribed and changed at this block; `false` otherwise. Omitted when not subscribed.

TrustChange.description: Inline new values of the trust-core fields at the block of the change envelope. Same shape as the trust-core fields in `schemas/v4/vt/response.schema.json`. The `corporationId` carries any DID-to-Corp re-binding that occurred at this block.

expiresAtTime.description: Earliest trust-flipping boundary per [IDX-VT-EVAL-2]; `null` when no boundary exists. NOT a TTL.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the resolved DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.
